description:
OUR SOLUTION

Future communication networks are getting more advanced, but also more complex. Analyzing such advanced networks, scenarios, algorithms, and protocols, require detailed radio network simulators. Magister Solutions Ltd. offers network simulations as a service targeted for the design, development, optimization and maintenance of satellite and terrestrial communication networks. The service, Magister SimLab, integrates the whole network simulation workflow into one service including scenario and campaign design, simulation execution and monitoring, and results analysis. 

CUSTOMER BENEFIT

Development of detailed system simulators for telecom and/or SatCom purposes require long lasting development projects requiring time, money, and competent personnel. We offer our detailed radio network simulators for use though the SimLab simulation service without massive development projects enabling reduced capital costs. Graphically defined guided simulation process shall speed-up the simulation workflow enabling to get results faster, and thus, reducing labor costs. SimLab service is built on a scalable, high performance cloud-based architecture with no capital costs and operational costs only based on use. 

COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE

Magister Solutions has a long history related to development of wireless technologies, network simulators and R&D services for both ESA and leading telecom and SatCom companies. This has given us a front seat view to the telecom industry enabling us to build state-of-the-art simulation services. Providing detailed network simulations as a service is a unique solution throughout the world. 

COMPANY

Magister Solutions is Finnish company specializing in network simulation tools and services for modelling real world telecom and SatCom in detail. We have been years up front in the technology development and standardization, working together with leading mobile and satellite communication organizations. 

SUMMARY

Magister Solutions Ltd. offers communication network simulations as a service targeted for the design, development, optimization and maintenance of satellite and terrestrial communication networks.

Since 2014 weAR, an innovative Italian SME, supports companies that are investing in the digital transformation 4.0, proposing digital platforms that allow the creation of innovative user manuals, which can be viewed with smartphones, tablets and smartglasses, offering advanced user experiences thanks to augmented and mixed reality.One of the main use cases is related to the support for maintenance activities, which aim to keep (or restore) an object (plant, component, ...) in a state where it can perform its required function. A Maintenance, Repair and Operation (MRO) market that will reach 774 billion Dollars in 2020, according to a study by Technavio.To increase business productivity, reducing errors, and optimizing staff training, weAR created MARKO, a process-oriented and totally codeless cloud platform that leverages augmented reality as a visual support for maintenance tasks.MARKO has been adopted by several international players in the energy and manufacturing sector, with great benefits in the timing and accuracy of execution, simplicity of use and intuitiveness compared to traditional paper-based and on-screen instructions.Our customers’ request to have a "digital twin" of their products on which overlap layers of content (coming from multiple information sources, such as IoT and EPR systems) and develop predictive maintenance activities, prompted the team to look for new solutions to improve the platform's user experience and increase its potential..MARKO, proposed as SaaS, has been adopted by electric companies (ENEL Group), and manufacture and conbsultancies enterprises (Ericsson, Indra, DS Group).weAR’s Augmented and Mixed reality solution has been tested as POC by Terna Spa, Vodafone Italia, Italian Air Force (AMI) and Leonardo Group and several SME in Italy.
Products and Services
1)MARKO, one of the first content management system / browser for instruction manual in augmented reality, is used by several international Enterprises. The main user is ENEL Group, the largest electric utility in Italy and one of the biggest utility worldwide. MARKO is used in Italy, Brazil and Spain. The use of augmented/mixed reality is a form of disruptive innovation in B2B field. Mainly, weAR's platform has competitive advantage due to his user friendliness. KPI's obtained from the first panel of users demonstrated the validity of the tool, especially in the presence of unskilled personnel. This simplicity-in-use is one of the main winning feature for market penetration. After 1,5 years in development, MARKO tool was proposed to the market since the end of 2016. It has generated revenue for more 500k€ until mid 2020.
2)DIGITAL TWIN EXPERIENCE IN VIRTUAL, AUGMENTED AND MIXED REALITY
The digital twin is a virtual copy of a real item. Using a smarglass, user can manipulate digital twin with the same user experience of the real product.The digital twin allows user to better know the correct usage of a product,with a real feel experience also without the presence of the real item. In addition, it can record user behavior in order to improve design and avoiding misuseWith the digital twin, maintenance and repair operations are very simple to illustrate, with step by step procedures to follow in real time.IoT, Ai, big data can support predictive maintenance, with a dynamic digital twin suggesting the user the correct procedure to better keep the product at top performance.

Biodiversity loss is happening at an accelerated rate, seeing more marine and land ecosystems affected by ocean acidification and human activities, as well as wildfires, flash floods, and natural disasters.

We help and support local, regional, national and international authorities, as well as private businesses, to extract actionable information based on assets they possess. 
AVINTERRA offers further management consultancy services to respond to business strategy development, data management and community engagement for geo-related projects. Driven by the mission to shape an innovative, creative and sustainable world for the Next Generation, the AVINTERRA team creates and supports STEAM educational projects worldwide, delivering train-the-trainer courses that have the power to enhance career prospects for space and geospatial sectors. The Future We Want for everyone worldwide, needs to address the critical role the Earth’s Sustainability plays and how important it is to cross-collaborate for the Beauty of our planet. We use efficient scientific communication to deliver our ambitious goals.

description:
DTM since 1994 is operating in many industrial sectors: aerospace, biomedical, marine and automotive. The company was born in the late ‘90 as spin-off of Ferrari SpA Space Division (former Ferrari Engineering). All the design and development activities are carried out in Modena premises and laboratories where are available many tools and facilities for design, manufacturing and testing. 
DTM main core-business is the design, development and qualification of aerospace structures and GSE for satellites, launchers and ISS/sub-orbital flight experiments and infrastructures. DTM facilities include CAD, structural, thermal and CFD software tools, clean rooms, autoclave, tools and NDI/test equipments, TVCs, static and fatigue test jigs, shaker and acquisition systems.
entityDescription: DTM is an engineering company working since 1994 in design (3D, structural, thermal, CFD) and MAIT of aerospace structures for satellites (primary, secondary, tertiary structures and instrument mechanical parts) and launchers as well as their ground support equipments (mechanical, fluidic, thermal). DTM is also involved in the development of micro-gravity infrastructures and experiments for parabolic flights, sounding rockets and International Space Station. DTM facilities include autoclave, tools and test equipments for manufacturing, qualification and testing of composite and sandwich parts. DTM capabilities include design and MAIT of thermal control systems as well as Mechanical-GSE, MT-GSE (thermal vacuum chambers) and Fluidic-GSE with special reference to extra high purity systems. Several test facilities are available in the 1000 m2 integration areas available at DTM integration sites like vacuum thermal chambers (also for cryogenic tests), static and fatigue test jigs, shaker, ISO 6 and ISO 8 clean rooms, acquisition systems, fluidic testing apparatus. entityDescription:
Since its establishment in 2011, our company has been engaged in materials science and technology R&D and innovation. The R&D and application of new and specialised materials and the technological development induced by industrial problems are together the basis for achieving good results.
Our scientific and engineering team is made up of young, talented scientists, engineers and experienced managers who take an innovative approach to solving unique frontier problems with a systems approach.
We have also taken our R&D results into the space sector, and with the help of our partners, we have tested special insulating materials in a real space environment on the ATL-1 2PQ satellite (5cmx5cmx10cm). We tested the insulation of on-board batteries during the 10-month orbital lifetime. In Hungary, this was the first privately built PQ satellite operating during its full orbital lifetime and the results were successful. It was the SMOG-P 1 PQ satellite and ours was the smallest operational, active smallest PQ satellite. The test of the insulators was successful, confirming the space qualification, and continuing the journey, further testing is currently underway aboard MRC-100. Several research and development projects are currently underway in the areas of special materials, energy storage and propulsion for 2PQ-16U scale applications.
Examples of our Science Department's areas of expertise in general and space:
- R&D of Li-ion and Na-ion batteries with increased volumetric energy density
- Li-ion and Li-ion based Li-ion and Li-ion based Li-ion alloys
- Development of nanoporous insulating materials for low and high temperature alumina applications
- Development of high efficiency thermoelectric materials
- Development of Cube satellite RCS actuator (0.1 - 1 N thrust) with water propellant
- Development of special heat-pipe solutions
- Hydrogen production, storage R&D
The main areas of expertise of our Technology Department are:
- Development of unique flow chemistry technologies,
- Custom equipment development up to TRL9
- Technology consulting, validation, feasibility studies, risk analysis,
- New generation energy storage systems,
In addition to our existing tasks, space and aerospace projects are playing an increasing role. This is another way of enriching the knowledge base of the international professional community in the long term.

description:
University College Dublin [UCD] is home to the UCD Centre for Space Research [C-Space: www.ucd.ie/space]. 
UCD C-Space is a university-wide centre for space-related research, innovation and education. 
Our purpose is to build partnerships that advance the use of space to address global scientific and societal challenges. 

We undertake internationally significant research in the following thematic areas: 
- Nanosatellites and Payloads [including EIRSAT-1 Ireland's first satellite]
- Space Structure Dynamics and Control 
- Earth Observation [data analysis and applications] 
- Ground- and Space-based Astrophysics
- Space Materials 
- Gamma-Ray Detectors 

We provide space-relevant university-based education and industry training courses [including Doing Business with ESA and Winning ESA proposals]. We further support industry through consultancy, collaborations, internships and access to facilities. 
C-Space builds national and global partnerships to deliver major space projects for Europe.
entityDescription: University College Dublin has its origins in the mid-nineteenth century under the leadership of the renowned educationalist John Henry Cardinal Newman. Since its foundation in 1854, the University has flourished and made a unique and substantial contribution to the creation of modern Ireland, based on successful engagement with Irish society on every level and across every sphere of activity. UCD is one of Europe's leading research-intensive universities; an environment where undergraduate education, masters and PhD training, research, innovation and community engagement form a dynamic spectrum of activity. The international standing of UCD has grown in recent years; it is currently ranked within the top 1% of institutions world-wide. UCD is also Ireland's most globally engaged university with over 30,000 students drawn from over 120 countries, and includes 5,500 students based at locations outside of Ireland. The University's main Dublin campus occupies an extensive parkland estate of more than 130 hectares and offers world-leading facilities including the UCD O'Brien Centre for Science, UCD Sutherland School of Law, UCD Lochlan Quinn School of Business and UCD Student Centre. As Ireland's largest university, with its great strength and diversity of disciplines, UCD embraces its role to contribute to the flourishing of Ireland; through the study and discussion of people, society, business, economy, culture, languages and the creative arts, as well as through research and innovation. The University's Strategy 2015-2020 outlines the objectives and major strategic initiatives set in place in order to accomplish UCD's mission and vision for this era.
